description: This PHP source file processes AJAX requests to dynamically generate tooltips based on the status of network components such as Ethernet, WiFi, MoCA interfaces, and firewall settings. It decodes incoming JSON configuration data, retrieves system state information via helper functions, and returns a JSON-encoded object containing target tags and corresponding tips.

methods.name: get_tips
methods.description: Generates context-specific tooltip messages based on the target interface and status provided.
